description.en: The ID of the NAS file system.

title.zh: 重置NAS文件系统的挂载点

descriptions.zh: 创建NAS文件系统时，系统将自动生成一个挂载点。默认情况下，该挂载点无需修改，如果该挂载点处于未激活状态，您需要重置NAS文件系统的挂载点。
descriptions.en: When you create a NAS file system, a mount target is automatically generated. By default, you do not need to modify the mount target of the NAS file system. If the mount target is disabled, you need to reset the mount target of the NAS file system.
